name: awui-desktop
description: The optional desktop app for awui: one window over the awui server this machine runs, or one it starts itself.

scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run stage:bin && electron-builder
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run stage:bin && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run stage:bin && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run stage:bin && electron-builder --win
